chunks: And Muawiya ibn Hakam narrated from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat, who raised it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"The grandmother has one-sixth [of the estate] with her son and with her daughter."
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a grandmother when she inherits with her son or daughter?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific case of the grandmother (al-jaddah) receiving one-sixth when accompanied by her own child, a ruling that distinguishes her share from the 'hijab' (exclusion) rules applied to other ascendants. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the principle that the grandmother’s share is derived from the Quranic provision for parents, extended by the Imams to include grandparents when the parent is deceased, ensuring her right is preserved alongside her direct descendant rather than being blocked by them.
